title: Filter and sort
name: filterSort
english: Filter the list by its filters and a search, then sort it by one column.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.sentence: One exact value per column; empty or all means no filter.

inputs.name: search
inputs.sentence: Text to look for, ignoring case.

inputs.name: searchFields
inputs.sentence: The columns the search looks in.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.sentence: The column to sort by and its direction.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.sentence: The rows the view shows, in order.

outputs.name: status
outputs.sentence: Whether any filter or search is active.

events.sentence: The person picks a value for a filter.
The person types in the search box.
The person sorts by a column.
The person clicks a column header to cycle its sort.
Every filter, the search and the sort are cleared.

wraps.concept: columnFilters, globalFilter, sorting [{id, desc}], getFilteredRowModel, getSortedRowModel
wraps.adapter: The view's sort is one entry of TanStack Table's sorting state and its filters are columnFilters keyed by column id.

signals.sentence: This function filters and sorts a list by hand.
This function searches a list by hand, ignoring case.
